01 Take a turn

Each turn costs 10 seeds. Choose a world before you turn. Seeds are free, with no cash value.

02 Make a match

Exactly two matching icons award 20 seeds. Any three matching icons unlock your chosen friend.

03 Come back tomorrow

When your seeds run out, return tomorrow for 50. If you still have seeds, your balance stays the same.

The small print, in plain words

Six equally likely symbols on each independent reel. Any triple wins the selected map’s collectible (1 in 36 turns on average, never guaranteed). Exactly two matching symbols award 20 seeds (41.67% of turns); three different symbols return none. A pair gains 10 seeds after the spin cost; a triple awards the friend and costs 10 seeds, with no extra seed payout.

Start with 200 seeds. A balance below the 10-seed spin cost refills to 50 at the next local midnight, once per calendar day, without accumulating missed days. One Kin and one Buttercup per browser save. Repeated wins do not add duplicates. You can switch maps between turns; already-won prizes stay available to claim. Seeds have no cash value and cannot be bought.
